text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 651, December 15, 1953 ]
CREATING THE ROXAS MEMORIAL COMMISSION TO TAKE CHARGE OF THE NATION-WIDE
CAMPAIGN FOR FUNDS FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF THE ROXAS MEMORIAL ON THE SITE
RESERVED FOR THE PURPOSE BY PROCLAMATION NO. 359 DATED DECEMBER 16, 1952, AND
FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF A LOW-COST HOUSING PROJECT FOR DISABLED WAR
VETERANS ON THE SITE RESERVED THEREFOR BY PROCLAMATION NO. 422 DATED
WHEREAS, the late President Manuel Roxas had the singular distinction of being the First President of the
Republic of the Philippines, in which position he rendered invaluable services to the country up to the time of
his death in the performance of an official engagement at Clark Field on April 15, 1948;
WHEREAS, the Filipino people, in expressing their gratitude for the patriotic services of the late President
Manuel Roxas, initiated the raising of funds by public subscription for the construction of an
income-producing Memorial for the purposes, among others, of immortalizing his memory, extending
financial aid to needy or indigent war widows and orphans, disabled war veterans and public charitable and
social welfare institutions, encouraging the development of theatrical talents, and promoting theatrical arts and
productions and symphony orchestra music; and
WHEREAS, certain parcels of the public domain situated in the City of Manila have been reserved for use as
site of the Roxas Memorial under Proclamation No. 359 dated December 16, 1952, and another parcel of land
situated in Diliman, Quezon City, has been reserved for use as site of a low-cost housing project for disabled
war veterans under Proclamation No. 422 dated November 12, 1953; Now, therefore, I, ELPIDIO QUIRINO,
President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law, do hereby create the Roxas
Memorial Commission composed of the following:
1. The Secretary of Public Works and Communications
................................
2. The Secretary of Commerce and Industry
................................
Vice-Chairman
3. The Administrator of Economic Coordinatio
................................
4. The Administrator, Social Welfare Administration
................................
5. The Treasurer of the Philippines
................................
Member and Treasurer
6. The Director, National Planning Commission
................................
7. Mrs. Trinidad de Leon Vda. de Roxas
................................
S. The President of War Widows
................................
9. The President, Chamber of Commerce of the Philippines
................................
10. The President, Manila Theater’s Association
................................
11. The Chairman, Board of Trustees, Arts Council of the Philippines
................................
The Commission shall be in charge of a nation-wide campaign for raising funds for the construction of the
Roxas Memorial the project to be known as Roxas Memorial Project No. 1, on the site reserved therefor by
Proclamation No. 863 dated December 16, 1952, and for the construction of a low-cost housing project in
Diliman, Quezon City, for disabled war veterans, the project to be known as Roxas Memorial Project. No. 2,
on the site reserved therefor by Proclamation No. 422 dated November 12, 1953. The Commission is hereby
authorized to create and organize as many subcommittees as it may deem necessary in the provinces,
chartered cities and municipalities, and to promulgate rules and regulations to carry out the work entrusted to
The Commission shall meet at such times and places as may be designated by the Chairman and shall submit
its report to the President from time to time.
All funds coming into the Commission shall be deposited with the Philippine National Bank or with any other
banking institution authorized to do business in the Philippines, and the necessary withdrawals therefrom shall
be made only by checks duly signed by the treasurer of the Commission and countersigned by the chairman
and by the auditor to be designated by the Auditor General.
Executive Order No. 635 dated October 27, 1953, is hereby revoked.
Done in the City of Manila, this 15th day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
fifty-three, and of the Independence of the Philippines, the eighth.
(SGD.) ELPIDIO QUIRINO
President of the Philippines
By the President:
(SGD.) MARCIANO ROQUE
Acting Executive Secretary
